name: Metal Wings
body:
School transmutation [metal]; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range personal

Target self

Duration 1 hour/level (D) or until expended

Metal: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate metal in some manner or conjure creatures composed of metal. Such spells are considered to belong to the Metal element (for geomancers) and the metal elemental school (for metal elementalists).

You sprout gleaming metal wings that grant you a 60-foot fly speed (good maneuverability). The speed is reduced to 40 if wearing medium or heavy armor or carrying a medium or heavy load.

While not flying, the wings can be used as secondary natural weapons. They deal 2d6 slashing damage and threaten on a 19-20. The wings can either have a single attack added to a full attack, or when only using the wings, two wing attacks as a full-attack action.

You can discharge the spell as a swift action to launch the metal “feathers” as a 30-foot cone that deals 10d6 piercing damage. A Reflex save halves this damage and spell resistance can protect a creature from this effect.
